result.title: MotorSense: A Video-EMG Dataset of Motoric Representations for Action Understanding
result.comment: NeurIPS 2026. 27 pages, 9 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://www.cs.umd.edu/~edessale/motorsense/
result.summary: Computer vision models learn hand action only from its visual consequences, without access to the underlying embodied motor signals. We address this absence with MotorSense, the first large-scale paired egocentric video and surface electromyography (EMG) dataset. MotorSense pairs bimanual EMG bands with egocentric video and yields synchronized video, bimanual EMG and IMU, and audio across 100 hours of unscripted manipulation. EMG offers a powerful scalable alternative to manual annotation: it captures finger movement, hand configuration, and the forces exerted between hand and environment as a dense signal free of occlusion and labeler bias, whereas manual annotation is costly, subjective, and unreliable under occlusion. We use MotorSense to learn sensorimotor alignment, producing an organization of action that is shared across the visual and motoric spaces, through cross-modal pre-training between video and EMG. The resultant vision models are then transferred to downstream tasks that benefit from sensorimotor alignment: in this case, action recognition, 3D hand reconstruction, and 3D contact reconstruction. We further demonstrate a generative application in which EMG motor signals are used to condition a video diffusion model, yielding videos of fine-grained hand manipulation. Across four action-centric computer vision tasks and eight popular video datasets, we demonstrate that sensorimotor alignment provides a stronger foundation for visual representation learning than conventional self-supervised learning methods over video, outperforming every baseline across all tasks and datasets evaluated.

AI.brief_summary: 构建首个大规模第一视角视频与双臂表面肌电（EMG）配对数据集（约 100 小时无脚本操作），通过视频-EMG 跨模态预训练学习感觉运动对齐，并迁移到动作识别、3D 手部与接触重建及 EMG 条件视频生成。
AI.relevance_reason: 把无遮挡的稠密肌电信号当作视觉表示的辅助监督，可能为「手部与接触等细节如何在内部表示中保留」提供训练期线索，但论文不涉及 latent 推理状态与停止决策，可供核查其对齐是否真能支撑细粒度推理。
